scope: Installed files read-only structure metadata only; no document/vendor XML text or font payload copied. This is not a supported HWT reader or editor.
conclusion: Schema streams contain length-prefixed UTF16LE XSD compressed as raw deflate. Instance streams contain XMLELEMENT mapping trees with SchemaXPath/field bindings; they are not ordinary XML instance documents. HWT editing requires explicit mapping/body synchronization, not the standalone XML workspace.
